title: Flight sessions
summary: Explicit flight protocol, headless hosts and predicted clients through public engine ports.

blocks.text: Provides session.flight@1.0.0 and retains space-sim-net/5 with space-sim-ships/1. Requires core.world, core.save, core.clock, core.motion and core.commands. Browser, offline and Node use the same code; no device, renderer or DOM dependency.

Host borrows a supplied privileged world and owns peers and its change subscription. A local session owns its world; a joined client owns its mirror. The caller schedules a shared world once; inputs, views and transports never step it. Disposal closes sessions and releases held controls before world disposal. Save and restore use the selected public codec and preserve legacy identity.

This explicit adapter retains flight ownership, command validation, snapshots, prediction replay, reconnect tokens, chat limits and shared pause/warp. A different entity or state schema needs its own compatible session adapter. Transport advertisements alone do not prove compatible state or commands.

Build and import through normal .spacemod tools and code consent. Choose a compatible replacement when a required service is removed. Downloaded modules never bypass authoritative identity or game-pack installation approval.

Authoritative v2 modules may contributeData adapters for world/player/entity records. Read session.world.data; request host-validated updates with session.dataCommand. Exact schemas negotiate space-sim-module-data/1; snapshots and revision deltas preserve reliable order independently of predicted flight. Save version 3 requires the active adapters and uses their one-version migrations. Ordinary worlds preserve their legacy saves and protocol. All replicated data is public to peers; keep credentials outside this store.
